reviews.review:
This game is a fresh take on the rougelike genre.  This game is great to pick up and play for a while with no real commitment.

The more you play this game, the more in game powerups you will unlock, which will give the game more depth.  The game has a random element to powerups, so some runs you will get destroyed, and others you will simply dominate.  There are also a handful of unlockable playable characters, each with their own unique play styles.

I love games I can just pick up and play, and this game is great for that.  It gets tough at times, but for the most part you will be destroying wave after wave of enemies, which is very satisfying.  If you are looking for something more than an hour here or there, this might not be your game.  

For ten bucks, I say its well worth it.

Amazing masterpiece of human mind.
This is platformer in which you should kill mobs which are spawning constantly until you activate portal. Also they get harder after every period of time so you wont mess around much. Difficult and easy (in different classes) so everybody can find a spot.
This game is awesome and if you don't have this game, why don't you have this game?

Background: Saw it on RedLetterMedia's review show and i believe anything that Rich Evans tells me. Also was pennies in the steam summer sale.

The Good:
* Weapons & upgrades have power and impact.. lots of em too
* Charming, retro, pixellated graphics
* Re-playability only added to by unlockable characters
* Plays great with keyboard or controller
* Great audio throughout

The Bad:
* While exits & upgrades are randomly placed the levels remain the same every time
* Unlocks and achievements are incredibly hard
* Boss fights are hard, and perma-death feels cruel at later levels.

Impressions: What a nightmare! It's rouge-like run and gun fun with random waves of enemies and crazy upgrades and meaty weapons. Only randomly generated levels could make the formula better.

Recommended for: those who like action, value for money and extremely challenging achievements.

Conclusion. Yonks of fun.
7/10. a good time for little cash and one you can pick up and put down at will.
